title: Direct GoTrue Password Grant Bypasses auth-login-guard Lockout
claim_or_requirement: CHK-SEC-01: Lockout enforced by server regardless of entry point
method: Static analysis of supabase/functions/auth-login-guard/index.ts and GoTrue endpoints
impact: Attackers can bypass the 15-minute brute-force lockout by issuing POST /auth/v1/token?grant_type=password directly to Supabase Auth API
recommendation: Implement native Supabase Auth Hook (before-user-sign-in) or configure pg_net / postgres database trigger to enforce lockout at the DB level

title: Lockout Denial of Service via Email-Only Hash
claim_or_requirement: CHK-SEC-02: Key is email+IP and no unauthenticated account lockout
impact: Edge function queries auth_attempts strictly by email_hash without IP binding. Any unauthenticated caller can lock out legitimate students or faculty
recommendation: Bind lockout attempts to IP address and client fingerprint; add progressive CAPTCHA instead of hard account denial

title: Privilege Escalation in accept-admin-invite Edge Function
claim_or_requirement: CHK-SEC-15: Accepting for different email & caller validation
impact: Function accepts arbitrary userId in JSON body without authenticating caller JWT or verifying userId matches invite.email. Any user with a leaked/intercepted token can elevate themselves to admin
recommendation: Verify caller auth.uid() against invite.email in database

title: Recruiter Role Referenced in Resumes Bucket Policy Does Not Exist
claim_or_requirement: CHK-ST-01: Storage policies valid and non-permissive
method: Static schema review of user_role enum and storage policies
impact: Docs state resumes are accessible by 'recruiter' but the role does not exist in user_role enum. Storage policy may fail or allow unintentional fallbacks
recommendation: Standardize role definitions in database and documentation

title: Entire mockData.ts Bundled in Production Client Bundle (2.66 MB)
claim_or_requirement: CHK-ENG-08: Mock data excluded from dist/
method: Vite build output & search of dist/assets/*.js
impact: Static imports in DataContext.tsx and MessagingPage.tsx prevent tree-shaking; all mock data and student emails are publicly exposed in production assets
recommendation: Refactor DataContext and MessagingPage to dynamically import mockData only inside DEV guards or extract mock seeds to separate packages

title: Design System Linter Fails with 47 Violations
impact: PRD claims 100% compliance with zero warnings. Reality shows 47 uppercase and contrast warnings across components
recommendation: Refactor uppercase headings to use <Eyebrow> primitive or remove uppercase utility classes

title: High Severity Vulnerability in sheetjs/xlsx
claim_or_requirement: CHK-ST-14: npm audit zero high/critical vulnerabilities
impact: Direct dependency xlsx@^0.18.5 has known Prototype Pollution and ReDoS. Context: currently used for export only so practical risk is low, but poses High risk when alumni CSV import is activated
recommendation: Replace sheetjs/xlsx with modern maintained alternatives (e.g. exceljs or papaparse for CSV only)

title: Content Security Policy Uses unsafe-inline and Lacks HSTS
impact: CSP permits 'unsafe-inline' for scripts and styles; Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) is completely missing
recommendation: Introduce cryptographic nonces for Vite scripts and add HSTS with max-age=31536000

title: Table Count Discrepancy (25 Actual vs 17 Claimed)
impact: Docs claim 17 tables; migrations define 25 tables with redundant legacy tables (login_attempts vs auth_attempts; jobs vs opportunities)
recommendation: Consolidate deprecated tables and update architecture documentation

title: Unintentional Grant of private Schema Functions to Public/Authenticated
impact: GRANT EXECUTE ON ALL FUNCTIONS IN SCHEMA private TO authenticated anon inadvertently exposes private.write_audit() allowing arbitrary callers to inject forged audit logs
recommendation: Revoke execute on private schema from authenticated and anon; grant execute only to specific helper functions like is_conversation_member()

title: message_reports Table Lacks Active RLS (ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY Missing)
claim_or_requirement: CHK-ST-01: RLS enabled and forced on every table
impact: Migration executes FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY but omitted ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY. In Postgres FORCE has no effect if RLS is not enabled; table may expose all reported message snapshots to any authenticated caller
recommendation: Execute ALTER TABLE public.message_reports ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY and add explicit admin/moderator-only SELECT policies

title: Legacy Direct INSERT Policy on chat_messages Bypasses V2 Validation and User Blocks
claim_or_requirement: CHK-ST-02: Legacy policies and RPC leftovers
impact: Old policy 'Users can send messages' was never dropped when V2 RPC was introduced. Authenticated users can insert directly into chat_messages bypassing user_blocks and conversation membership
recommendation: Drop legacy INSERT policy and revoke direct INSERT on chat_messages from authenticated; require send_message_v2 RPC

title: Credentials Committed in Git History (.env.backup)
impact: Commit 28a6fd2 committed .env.backup containing Supabase project URL and publishable anon key. Although removed from HEAD it persists in git commit objects
recommendation: Rotate anon key if sensitive and scrub git history using git filter-repo or BFG

title: Absence of Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for Administrative Console
method: Static check of Supabase config and auth flows
impact: Institutional admin console with super-admin powers has no MFA enforcement or step-up authentication before bulk graduation or user deletion
recommendation: Enable Supabase MFA (TOTP) and enforce step-up auth on admin routes and RPCs

title: Supabase config.toml Missing from Version Control
claim_or_requirement: CHK-ST-09: Auth and environment config codified
impact: supabase/config.toml is completely absent from git repository. GoTrue settings password policy rate limits and JWT lifetime cannot be reviewed or versioned
recommendation: Initialize and commit supabase/config.toml with institutional hardening standards
